column1: # roll-up targets that are lineage-level umbrellas; read by rollup.py, which fails on a term
# that is not in cell_type_targets.tsv, whose label differs from the CL release, or that is not
# an is_a ancestor of another target. A native cell type that rolls up to one of these AND is
# itself an is_a ancestor-or-self of some other target (it is coarser than the target list:
# 'leukocyte', 'myeloid leukocyte', 'erythroid lineage cell') is left out of the cross-dataset
# summary; a native type with nothing finer in the target list (pro-B cell, urothelial cell)
# still pools there. A native term with no target ('neural cell', 'stem cell') is never left out,
# even when it sits above targets.
# A target that is an ancestor of other targets but is the natural resolution of many datasets
# (e.g. endothelial cell, macrophage, neuron, stromal cell) is deliberately not listed.
